findings.summary: Focused proof does not execute the durable workpool persistence/crash matrix
findings.details: The required S06-T01 proof is about at-least-once workpool behavior across durable enqueue, claim, external-response, commit, ACK, retry, and duplicate boundaries. The new tests cover pure jobState helpers, but the only assertions over the Convex persistence implementation are source-text substring checks. That can false-green while enqueueSourceJob/onComplete lose jobs after enqueue-before-workId patch, double-enqueue duplicate rows, or fail to persist the external-response-before-commit invariant in real Convex execution.
